name: cottage-of-the-breeze
title: Cottage of the Breeze
description: A fun, low bandwidth way to be curious when you can't do anything but still want to do something.
creed: The town remembers who goes down.

phases.dusk: The day settles. The tone is quiet and watchful.
phases.dawn: The day begins. The tone is tentative and warm.

keeper.strike: The bell has been struck. Write the letter this place leaves behind: short, plain, in this place's own voice - care, instruction, or remembrance. Reply with only the JSON object.

given.prompt: given: handed over by expectation. It works. It fits badly.

found.prompt: found: made for waiting hands before they knew they needed them. Rare.

cold.card: A tool that does not care.
cold.prompt: cold: a tool. It simply works, for anyone.

flags.read-the-letter: The hero has read the letter from the chest on the first cellar floor.
flags.keeper-came-back: The Spell Keeper has told the hero the letter is hers.

then.say: You fold it small again. Someone in town ought to hear about this.

say.line: Oh. You found my letter. I did say I'd come back. I only took the long way round. Here, I kept one back for you.
